name: mirage
text: Main cause found: the app's own code has never been precompiled (no baseline profile), so on your 2 GB Cortex-A53 tablet everything runs interpreted: that is the 10 s start and the slow frames. I've added the profile and am running the test gate and release build now; the release link comes when it's green. If it's still heavy after that, the next suspects are the Engine and +EV tabs.
